latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Video Best v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly turn up to 20 JPG photos into polished 1080p videos by describing your desired result.
- One-step cloud processing: just upload photos and specify your request—no timeline editing or export settings required.
- Automatic setup: generates your connection and session tokens for seamless access, with clear user notifications at each step.
- Supports quick actions like video export, balance checks, and file uploads; all major formats (mp4, mov, avi, etc.) are supported.
- Built-in keyword detection and intent handling for prompts about aspect ratio, music, overlays, and export.
- Robust error handling for missing tokens, session issues, unsupported files, and rate limits.
